command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin
git checkout integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
git reset --hard origin/integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "d2a7bc285e2b67c342c7ea80ffaca00e6e8c5e0e" ]
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('tests/zigbee_device_emulator/managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl')
needles=['create_cluster_desc','cluster_desc_add','attr_desc','create_attr','add_attr','ATTR_ACCESS_REPORTING']
for p in sorted(root.rglob('*.h')):
    ls=p.read_text(errors='ignore').splitlines()
    hits=[i for i,l in enumerate(ls) if any(n in l for n in needles)]
    if not hits: continue
    if '/cluster/' in str(p) and not any('zcl_common' in str(p) or 'zcl_core' in str(p) for _ in [0]):
        # Skip generated per-cluster wrappers unless they expose a generic descriptor primitive.
        if not any(('ezb_zcl_create_' in ls[i] or 'ezb_zcl_cluster_desc_' in ls[i] or 'ezb_zcl_attr_desc' in ls[i]) for i in hits):
            continue
    print('===',p,'===')
    shown=set()
    for i in hits:
        lo=max(0,i-6); hi=min(len(ls),i+12)
        if (lo,hi) in shown: continue
        shown.add((lo,hi))
        print('\n'.join(f'{j+1}:{ls[j]}' for j in range(lo,hi)))
PY
